description: lint-router hooks — prepare the right lint profile automatically so the check is ready the moment it's needed. SessionStart + PostToolUse(EnterWorktree) run the router in --setup-only mode (idempotent): for a Slate web-app it writes the gitignored overlay; for your own repos it ensures the bundled deps are installed (one-time) in the stable state dir; elsewhere it's a silent no-op. Never lints here — that's the skill's job.
